extracted.intended_audience: people living with Parkinson's, researchers, clinicians, donors, and research advocates
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational overview of the Parkinson's Foundation's research strategy, initiatives, participant-facing studies, and funding programs, including goals for trial matching, genetics testing, and grant support. Describes programs for patients, researchers, and donors and ways to get involved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multi-disciplinary research strategy
rubrics_metrics.description: There is still a lot we do not know about Parkinson’s disease (PD). The Parkinson’s Foundation drives a multi-disciplinary research strategy to close the gaps in knowledge about Parkinson’s – from its basic biology to its impact on the brain and its effects on people.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guides the Foundation’s funding and program priorities; emphasizes comprehensive, cross-discipline approaches that span basic biology through clinical effects to accelerate translation into improved treatments and care.

rubrics_metrics.name: Accelerate findings into improved treatments and care
rubrics_metrics.description: We work to accelerate our findings, quickly applying them to improved treatments and care today.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program and research selection should favor projects with feasible translation pathways or clear potential to change patient care in the nearer term.

rubrics_metrics.name: Big-picture approach to identify fastest lanes to new therapies
rubrics_metrics.description: We spur discovery by taking a comprehensive, big-picture approach to research. This approach is vital to identifying the fastest lanes to new therapies for the 10 million people living with Parkinson's in the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize research that targets high-impact, high-likelihood paths to therapies; consider population-level impact and scalability when assessing projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: PD GENEration — patient eligibility and offering
rubrics_metrics.description: PD GENEration: Powered by the Parkinson’s Foundation, which is an international research initiative offering genetic testing and counseling to people with PD at no cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility/target: people with Parkinson’s disease; program metric includes accessibility (no-cost genetic testing and counseling) and international participation.

rubrics_metrics.name: PD Trial Navigator — trial matching and recruitment goal
rubrics_metrics.description: PD Trial Navigator, which is a pilot program connecting PD GENEration participants to relevant clinical trials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program objective/metric: improve trial matching and recruitment among PD GENEration participants to accelerate development of new therapies; success judged by improved matching rates and recruitment speed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Improve trial matching and recruitment to speed therapy development
rubrics_metrics.description: How PD Trial Navigator aims to improve trial matching and recruitment, which can speed up the development of new therapies and a cure for PD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Evaluation should consider metrics like time-to-enrollment, match accuracy, participant retention, and impact on trial timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Parkinson’s Outcomes Project — measure differences in care and impact
rubrics_metrics.description: Differences in care dramatically impact daily life with Parkinson’s. Our Parkinson’s Outcomes Project findings can help you advocate for your best care. Study findings have led to best practices and accelerating research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value projects that measure care variation and link findings to actionable best practices; impact measured by changes in care delivery, patient outcomes, and adoption of best practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding inclusivity — who the Foundation funds
rubrics_metrics.description: Our competitive awards and grants fund a diverse array of Parkinson's research. We fund all types of researchers from early career and established scientists to clinicians who treat patients every day.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility and selection favor a diversity of investigator career stages and roles (early-career, established scientists, clinician-researchers); programs are competitive and meant to support varied research portfolios.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient-centered research prioritization via research advocates
rubrics_metrics.description: Learn more about our research advocate program to help us ensure more funds are directed towards research that matters to people with PD.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Involve research advocates (people with PD and caregivers) in priority-setting to align funding with patient-centered needs; success judged by degree to which funded research addresses advocate-identified priorities.
